---
name: Feature request
about: A new capability or improvement
title: '[feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## What you want

A clear description of the feature.

## Why it matters

The problem this solves. Concrete examples help.

## Proposed approach (optional)

If you've thought about implementation, share it. If not, that's fine.

## Compatibility with scope

ProjectLens is deliberately lightweight, deterministic, framework-aware, and secure (see `GOVERNANCE.md`). Does your feature fit those constraints? If it adds a heavy dependency, a network call, or new code-execution surface, it probably needs a deeper discussion before implementation.
